preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.
For each test case, the number of nodes N is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
For each test case, the number of main roads M is between 0 and 120,000 inclusive.
The source node S is a valid node index between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: All given main roads connect distinct valid nodes within the range [1, N].
The number of provided edge pairs matches M.

preconditions.expression: len(set(tuple(sorted(e)) for e in edges)) == M
preconditions.description: There are no duplicate edges between any pair of nodes.
It is guaranteed that the complement graph (village roads) is connected, ensuring a path exists between any pair of nodes.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N - 1 for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly N-1 integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(v.isdigit() for v in line.split()) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: All values in the output lines are non-negative integers.
For each test case, the i-th integer in the output line (0-indexed) corresponds to the shortest distance from S to node (i+2) in the complement graph, where nodes are ordered 1 to N, skipping S.
The distances represent the minimum number of edges in the complement graph (village roads) required to travel from S to the target node.
